story: NVIDIA reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
method: Independent re-check: pages fetched again from this environment, canonical URLs and NVIDIA RSS checked, SEC EDGAR 8-Ks opened, independent report (CNN) opened, quotes matched character by character; no correction, withdrawal or superseding notice found on the newsroom pages or RSS.

claims.claim: Jensen Huang resigned as NVIDIA's President, CEO and director
evidence: SEC 8-K: 'On November 11, 2026, the Board ... accepted the resignation of Jen-Hsun Huang, as NVIDIA's President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board, effective immediately.'
Newsroom 12 Nov: 'Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.'
claims.contradictions: Previous script said he resigned on 12 November; the 8-K gives the event date as 11 November and the announcement was 12 November. Corrected.

evidence: SEC 8-K: 'the Board appointed ... Colette M. Kress, age 59, to serve as interim Chief Executive Officer'

claims.claim: Harvey C. Jones became Chair of the Board
evidence: SEC 8-K: 'On November 11, 2026, the Board appointed Harvey C. Jones, age 73, as Chair of the Board.'
Newsroom 12 Nov: 'first-ever Chair of the Board'

claims.claim: NVIDIA reinstated Huang as President, CEO and director, effective immediately
evidence: Newsroom 23 Nov and SEC 8-K Exhibit 99.1 (dated 23 Nov): 'effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer, and as a member of the Board.'
CNN page links 'Nvidia board reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO'
Newsroom 23 Nov and SEC Ex.99.1: 'The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang'

claims.claim: Quote: 'I can’t wait to get back to work.' (Jensen Huang)
evidence: Exact wording present in Newsroom 23 Nov and SEC Ex.99.1

evidence: Newsroom 23 Nov and SEC Ex.99.1: 'in light of recent reporting that Mr. Huang has been the target of a foreign intelligence effort, the Board formed a committee ... will proceed to conclusion.'
claims.contradictions: none; the underlying allegations are not verified and are not stated

claims.claim: New oversight: National Security and Export Control Committee; search for a Chief Compliance Officer
evidence: Newsroom 23 Nov: both measures; RSS shows a 17 Nov release establishing the committee

claims.claim: Nvidia says he spent 33 years building the company
evidence: Newsroom 12 Nov, Kress: 'the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years'

claims.claim: Shares rose about 30% after the reinstatement
evidence: Only headlines (CNN page links; search excerpts)

corrections: Resignation event date is 11 Nov 2026 (8-K); the announcement was 12 Nov. The script now says Nvidia announced it on 12 Nov, and the hook says 'less than two weeks' instead of 'eleven days'.
